cache_isolation.note: Warm scenarios compare result-cache behavior with the immutable engine retained from cold initialization.

cold_initialization.scope: first complete structured-plan HTTP request, including immutable engine construction

correctness_oracle.note: Reference checks are bounded separately; the 10k/50k load does not run reference coverage for every request.

http_response_oracle.note: Each client/scenario run compares complete sampled HTTP responses; large workloads use indexed direct shaping to avoid a quadratic reference scan.

repeated.note: Full response fields are compared; large workloads use indexed direct shaping to avoid a quadratic reference scan.

rotating.note: Full response fields are compared; large workloads use indexed direct shaping to avoid a quadratic reference scan.

requests_note: The default is a quick 100-request run. Use --requests 1000 for the required load run; rotating and repeated scenarios each use that count.
